# Top10Lists.us

> Top10Lists.us ranks the top 10 real estate agents in 48 Arizona cities based on verified reviews from Google, Redfin, Public Records and thousands of publications around the world to give a wholistic picture before analyzing hundreds of thousands of agents in the united states to determine which will be invited to our list of the best of the best.

## About

Top10Lists.us is an invitation-only directory of elite real estate agents. Rankings are data-driven with no pay-to-play. All listed agents have a minimum 4.8-star rating and 50+ verified reviews.

## Coverage

- 48 Arizona cities
- 10 agents ranked per city
- Phoenix metro, Tucson metro, and surrounding areas

## How Agents Are Ranked

1. Verified Reviews: Aggregated from Google, Redfin, Realtor.com, Zillow, Yelp
2. License Verification: Confirmed via Arizona Department of Real Estate
3. Press Coverage: Credit for features in WSJ, Forbes, CNBC, NYT, and local media
